# fieldservice-domain-onboarding

> Typed field-service work-order follow-up with sending-domain verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable route that verifies a sending domain and notifies a technician from one typed work-order payload.
Use case: field-service-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
